rationale:
Evidence: Iteration 7 (344.5) is the best design so far, with 17 of 20 oval finishes and mean progress 0.95. Its s-bend and slalom runs still end off-track (progress 0.34 and 0.11), with 1.15 and 1.25 line-loss events and steering oscillation of 0.22 and 0.14. Iteration 8 scored exactly the same as iteration 7 to four decimals on every track, although its geometry (mass 0.5, wheel_track 0.09) and kd (0.8) differed. Iteration 6 showed the same pattern against iteration 5. I therefore cannot tell whether iteration 8's changes reached the simulator, so I am not treating them as evidence. The only verified gain is the iteration-7 plant change (lower body_length and mass, narrower wheel_track, sensors at y=0.06).

Decision: Keep the verified iteration-7 geometry exactly (sensors 8 mm at x=-0.016 to +0.016, y=0.06; wheel_track 0.10; wheel_radius 0.03; body 0.12 x 0.12; mass 0.6). Keep kp 2.0, ki 0.1 and base_speed 1.3, which are unchanged from the best run. The one controller change is kd from 0.6 to 0.8, a small damping increase aimed at the s-bend and slalom oscillation (0.22 and 0.14). It is a low-risk step, because the oval finish is driven by the speed and geometry that are kept fixed. Expected result: oval completion rate at or near 0.85, s-bend and slalom oscillation slightly lower, and a score close to or above 344. If the result matches iteration 8 exactly again, that will confirm the simulator is not responding to some of my changes, and the next iteration should check that.
